name: V53_accepted_protocol_audit
description: Use the repo's accepted V53 benchmark: day5 full-user crossfit and day6 future-date holdout. A candidate is valid only if it is evaluated on a genuinely unseen future cohort and not merely on the same retained label set used to generate the V53 replay.

days.5: full-day5 user-crossfit; not a second future temporal fold
days.6: future-day6 benchmark; valid future event set

notes: V53 remains the accepted local baseline.
The earlier v61 results are not a valid model improvement because the same labels and cohort are used for scoring.
No official or upload-worthy score is implied by this benchmark.

reports.label: day5_user_crossfit
reports.reason: Candidate is scored on the same timestamps/labels as the V53 replay; it is not a valid future unseen holdout.
